reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system is a photonics-based CE THz ISAC system that integrates 2D positioning and CFP. The system uses a dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator to generate the IF ISAC signal, which is then up-converted to the THz band using optical heterodyne detection. The ISAC signal is designed with two LFM sub-bands and a CE-OFDM signal in between. The system uses CFP to synthesize a 10 GHz bandwidth from the two 2 GHz LFM sub-bands, achieving a radar range resolution of 1.78 cm. The system also demonstrates a communication data rate of 18.448 Gbit/s.
